Method of Attack: Malspam campaigns distributing IQY (Excel Web Query) attachments that when opened pull external data containing Excel formulas which execute PowerShell scripts to download and install malware
Use of IQY files to launch PowerShell commands that download and run scripts to install malware
Use of legitimate remote administration tool AMMYY Admin by attackers to gain remote access to victim computers
Attack Vector: Malicious IQY email attachments in malspam campaigns
Indicators of Compromise: IQY attachments in spam emails pretending to be purchase orders, scanned documents, or unpaid invoices
Remote URLs queried by IQY files such as https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/misc/test.txt
PowerShell commands executed via Excel formulas embedded in external data
Use of AMMYY Admin remote administration tool installed by malware
